milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining cracked_stone_bricks with a pickaxe drops the block as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 cracked_stone_bricks in inventory (verified via /clear command), so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over count_in_box_at_most(kind=block) because inventory_has directly and reliably confirms the player performed the mining action and collected the result.
